paper_title: New Constraints on Dark Photon Dark Matter with Superconducting Nanowire Detectors in an Optical Haloscope
notes: LAMPOST proof-of-concept optical haloscope with SNSPD, 180 hr exposure. New 90% CL exclusion on dark photon kinetic mixing in mass range ~0.7-0.8 eV at epsilon ~1e-12, improving existing limits (FUNK, SENSEI, Xenon10, Xenon1T solar) by up to a factor of two. No numerical table provided; data points are approximate values from the abstract/text ('kinetic mixing eps >~ 1e-12'). The actual limit curve in Fig. 4 oscillates due to substrate thickness effects, so these flat approximate values carry moderate uncertainty. Paper also mentions future axion-photon sensitivity with magnetic field, but the measured result is DarkPhoton only.
